description: Implement Gate B optional-generation safety and provider integration after FEAT-002: deterministic prompt budgeting, a pinned calibrated claim entailment verifier with whole-candidate fallback, sandboxed Kiro CLI/OpenAI, Ollama and optional PEFT providers, and a live redacted Kiro CLI connectivity attempt. Extractive mode remains the accepted default.
steps: Add /projects/sandbox/AcharyaGPT/.worktrees/rag-rebuild/prompts/grounded_v1.txt and deterministic provider-specific byte/token budgeting with complete-context selection and compact citation renumbering.

Pin MoritzLaurer/DeBERTa-v3-base-mnli-fever-anli revision 6f5cf0a2b59cabb106aca4c287eed12e357e90eb and resolved file hashes; implement 512-token premise-window/hypothesis claim entailment in /projects/sandbox/AcharyaGPT/.worktrees/rag-rebuild/src/acharya/rag/grounding.py, calibrate 0.50..0.99 against supported and adversarial unsupported claims, and reject the whole candidate to extractive/abstention on any unsupported claim or stale verifier evidence.

Implement /projects/sandbox/AcharyaGPT/.worktrees/rag-rebuild/src/acharya/providers/kiro_cli.py, kiro_openai.py, ollama.py, and peft_local.py with common immutable contracts, typed errors, bounded service-owned retry/correction, no pre-validation DNS, tools-disabled isolated subprocesses, redaction, and unchanged RAG/safety/support gates.

Run fake-provider and API integration suites proving exact prompt parity and no rejected-candidate leakage. Generative readiness must remain false when support calibration is missing even if a transport is healthy.

Invoke provider-check against /projects/sandbox/AcharyaGPT/.worktrees/rag-rebuild/.env.local without opening/sourcing/printing it; store only allowlisted KIRO_API_OK check metadata and report PASSED or an honest UNVERIFIED/BLOCKED_EXTERNAL_PROVIDER status.
acceptance_criteria: Prompt bytes, complete history trimming, output reservation, context scanning, and compact citation numbering are deterministic across CLI/HTTP/Ollama/PEFT adapters.
Every substantive sentence/list claim is tested only against its cited context windows with the locked NLI revision and hash-matching threshold; citation coverage alone cannot pass support.

Negation, entity/number swaps, unsupported causality/diagnosis/dose, citation laundering, malformed output, timeout, and failed correction reject the entire candidate and return only safe extraction or fixed abstention.

Kiro CLI uses shell=False, mode-0700 isolated cwd, minimized environment, bounded streams/process-group timeout, exact kiro-cli 2.26.0, and literal --trust-tools=; logs/records never expose key, prompt, stdout/stderr, response, environment, or raw exception.
Kiro HTTP performs no DNS unless key, HTTPS/loopback URL, model, and context-window tokens all validate; PEFT cannot load an unhashed/mismatched adapter or disable RAG.
The real Kiro connectivity attempt records only a passed exact KIRO_API_OK or an honest categorized external blocker; no successful API claim is inferred.
verification: PYENV_VERSION=3.11.15 uv run --project /projects/sandbox/AcharyaGPT/.worktrees/rag-rebuild python -m acharya.cli calibrate-support --workspace /projects/sandbox/AcharyaGPT/.worktrees/rag-rebuild

PYENV_VERSION=3.11.15 uv run --project /projects/sandbox/AcharyaGPT/.worktrees/rag-rebuild python -m acharya.cli provider-check --workspace /projects/sandbox/AcharyaGPT/.worktrees/rag-rebuild --provider kiro-cli --env-file /projects/sandbox/AcharyaGPT/.worktrees/rag-rebuild/.env.local --record /projects/sandbox/AcharyaGPT/.worktrees/rag-rebuild/artifacts/provider-check/kiro.json
findings: Implemented deterministic grounded_v1 prompt construction with complete-pair history trimming, whole-context scanning, byte/token/output reservation, and compact citation renumbering; extractive remains the configured and service default. Added whole-candidate generated-answer validation covering sentence/list citation parsing, existing medical-safety policy, cited-context-only NLI, malformed/table/uncited rejection, and extractive fallback with no rejected-text leakage. Locked MoritzLaurer/DeBERTa-v3-base-mnli-fever-anli at revision 6f5cf0a2b59cabb106aca4c287eed12e357e90eb with all 10 resolved file SHA-256 values. Real CPU calibration succeeded: model hash 4cf65d6f80c4414d1e6673cbc5528e385cb3cbe7d266b518b171dff2474bcd1f, evaluation hash 43b777a381bcd8326648e349002cf11751b9c32388817915d02388a98add2a01, threshold 0.98, 4/4 supported claims accepted, 0/8 unsupported claims accepted, artifact SHA-256 29d04e03f57d1c41db11825d80f2e51f388e530ef4e920d0e93e42477faa1440. Added immutable typed provider contracts plus sandboxed kiro-cli, validated OpenAI-compatible Kiro HTTP, loopback-only Ollama, and hash-locked PEFT adapters; provider transports do not own retries, while the service owns at most one bounded correction/retry and requires fresh support calibration before invocation. Exact FEAT-003 provider/grounding suite passed (10 tests), redaction/API suite passed (4 tests), full suite passed (48 tests), uv lock/Ruff/strict mypy passed, and offline Gate A was rerun PASSED after the config changes. Live Kiro check loaded .env.local only inside the application and ran kiro-cli 2.26.0 in a mode-0700 isolated directory with shell disabled and literal --trust-tools=. The CLI transport exited 0 but did not return exactly KIRO_API_OK, so status is honestly UNVERIFIED/response_mismatch; no access success is claimed. The allowlisted record SHA-256 is 127d61f84d3bf5eaf4e5efe98b6383e6e73498d6107d63feb403f812ee8196f8 and contains credential_recorded:false with no prompt, response, streams, environment, exception, or credential. Later-step needs: retain this provider blocker until an exact response passes, keep optional generation off unless the hash-matching support artifact is present, and preserve FEAT-002's separate BLOCKED_EXTERNAL_DATA Kaggle component while iOS/bundle/training work proceeds.
